question: A phasor vector of length $V_m$ rotates counter-clockwise with an angular velocity $\omega$ about the origin. If you plot the vertical projection (y-component) of this rotating vector against time $t$, identify the standard mathematical function that describes the resulting graph.

options.C: An exponential decay function $y = V_m e^{-t}$
